source_note: Preliminary rule-based screen only. No zoning API exists pan-India for hackathon scope; final clearance always rests with revenue / panchayat / municipal authority. Rule fires -> flag with exact rule id, never an AI paragraph.
disclaimer: Preliminary check only — final regulatory clearance rests with the concerned authority.

rules.when: land_type == agricultural AND business_category in [manufacturing, cold_storage, ev_charging, processing]
rules.flag: Land conversion (NA) may be required before commercial construction.
rules.ask_user: Is the plot NA-converted or earmarked commercial/industrial in the Master Plan?

rules.when: osm_water_layer within 500m OR user answers eco_zone == no
rules.flag: Water-body / eco-sensitive proximity — additional clearance likely.
rules.ask_user: Is the plot at least 500m from river/water body/protected forest?

rules.when: road_frontage_m < 12 AND business needs heavy vehicles
rules.flag: Narrow frontage — truck entry and setback NOC may be an issue.
rules.ask_user: Does the plot have >=12m direct road frontage?

rules.when: needs 3-phase power OR cold chain AND no sanctioned load
rules.flag: Power/water sanction needed before machinery installation.
rules.ask_user: Is 3-phase line and reliable water available?

rules.flag: Gram Panchayat / Municipal NOC required for commercial setup.
rules.ask_user: Can local Panchayat/Municipal NOC be obtained?

rules.flag: FSSAI registration/license will be required before sale.
